name: VoidkitCore
description:
Core runtime for the Voidkit server suite.

Provides the plugin contract, service registry, data storage, text/colour parsing and the placeholder system. It also bundles the Kotlin runtime, so the other voidkit-* plugins do not carry their own copy.

Installing this alone adds no gameplay content - it is the shared foundation the other plugins require.

Server-side only. Clients do not need it.
